settings.nav: Show Kudos Wall in the sidebar
settings.allowance_help: How many kudos each member can give a week (1 to 50). Unused kudos don't carry over.
settings.group_allowances_help: Leave a group empty to use the number above. A member in several groups gets the most any of them allows.
settings.timezone_help: A new week (and new kudos) starts at midnight here. A change to this or the start day takes effect when the current week ends, so this week's kudos and allowances stay as they are.
settings.timezone_forum: The forum's timezone (UTC if none is set)
settings.min_account_days: Account age before kudos count toward the spotlight (days)
settings.min_account_days_help: Kudos from newer accounts still show on the wall; they just don't help anyone into the spotlight. 0 counts everyone.
settings.moderation_help: New kudos wait in a queue on the wall until a moderator approves them. Moderators' own kudos skip the queue. With the queue on, the spotlight is picked a day into the new week, so late approvals still count.
settings.banner: Show the spotlight banner above the discussion list
settings.banner_help: Last week's most-thanked member, while this week runs. Members can hide it.

spotlight.heading: Weekly spotlight
spotlight.help: Every week, once it ends, the member who got the most kudos goes in the spotlight (ties go to whoever got there first). Unconfirmed and suspended members are skipped. The forum's scheduler must be running.
spotlight.group: Put the spotlight member in a group for a week
spotlight.group_help: They join it for the week after theirs and leave it when the next spotlight is chosen. Members who were in it already stay in it.
spotlight.group_none: Create a group under Permissions first (the built-in groups can't be used).
spotlight.badge: Give the spotlight member a badge
spotlight.badge_help: From FoF Badges, kept for good. Only badges without an automatic rule are listed.
spotlight.badge_needs_fof: Enable FoF Badges to give a badge as well.
spotlight.never_run: The scheduler hasn't run yet. Set up a cron job for php flarum schedule:run.
